description: Intent i009 (if-alt-count, snapshot s02) complete with two reported findings and one unresolved candidate family. Finding 1 (medium confidence): drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx.c:307-318 (stv06xx_isoc_init) and :320-336 (stv06xx_isoc_nego) index gspca_dev->dev->actconfig->intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1].endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize with no num_altsetting>1 or bNumEndpoints>0 check; the nego path WRITES that 16-bit field before usb_set_interface, so a malicious device declaring one altsetting or an endpointless alt-1 gets an OOB write/NULL-deref at streaming start; identical pattern at drivers/media/usb/gspca/xirlink_cit.c:2645 and 2668. Core usb_set_interface validates altnums but runs after the driver's direct cache mutation, so it does not protect this access. Finding 2 (high confidence): drivers/staging/media/usbvision/usbvision-video.c:1435-1438 indexes dev->actconfig->interface[usbvision_device_data[model].interface]->altsetting[0] on the model-driven branch with no bNumInterfaces bound, while the sibling ifnum branch explicitly checks ifnum < bNumInterfaces — proving the check was known and omitted; the immediately following reads of interface->desc.bNumEndpoints and &interface->endpoint[1].desc dereference the unvalidated interface pointer at probe (plug-in). Evidence-backed negatives recorded: gspca.c:1474 audio-interface loop (NULL-safe, bounded by bNumInterfaces), xusbatm.c:45/139 (NULL-checked, usb_altnum_to_altsetting + bNumEndpoints-bounded), qcserial.c:234 (nintf-guarded), cx231xx-audio.c:610 (seed family, endpoint checks present), and core config.c:740 documents that the core only warns on bNumInterfaces mismatch (so driver-side checks are required). Unresolved: sound/usb fixed altsetting[1] literals (pcm.c:393/913, quirks.c:166/211/425, mixer.c:2948, mixer_quirks.c:1513, misc/ua101.c:906-1011, midi.c:1085/1970) likely derive safety from parser-built format tables but were not fully traced; runtime S_ALT re-validation handlers were only spot-checked (uvc/gspca/em28xx paths looked bounded). Artifacts: findings/i009.json (validated JSON, snapshots_checked ["s02"]) and checkpoints/i009.json updated to complete.
